description: Answers to comments on Instagram, Threads, Facebook Page, YouTube, TikTok, Bluesky and Mastodon posts waiting for a tap (suggested: from an auto-reply, or drafted by an assistant with comment_answers_draft), on their way (queued, with send_after; sending), or failed. status: "sent" lists the last week's answers instead, "all" the last week's of every status (skipped ones say why in note), "inbox" the waiting ones plus the last week's sent ones, which is what Inbox shows. rule_id narrows to one auto-reply. Each answer's outcome says what to do: ready and needs_attention (the DM didn't go) and failed want a person; replied and dm_sent (a rule already answered it) want nothing. counts is the one number to quote for how many comments wait.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: comment_replies_list
